title_pt: Arara-azul apreendida na fronteira em Bela Vista
title_en: Hyacinth macaw seized at the border in Bela Vista
title_es: Guacamayo jacinto decomisado en la frontera en Bela Vista
card_text_pt: Dois paraguaios foram detidos com uma arara-azul capturada em propriedade no lado brasileiro da fronteira e transportada em veículo.
card_text_en: Two Paraguayan men were detained with a hyacinth macaw captured on the Brazilian side of the border and transported by vehicle.
card_text_es: Dos paraguayos fueron detenidos con un guacamayo jacinto capturado en el lado brasileño de la frontera y transportado en vehículo.

context_en: [O] Two Paraguayan men were detained with a hyacinth macaw captured on the Brazilian side of the border and transported by vehicle. [S] Wendt-Oliveira et al. [N] The News Repository reference is used only as thematic context and not as evidence for this event.
